Coral Terrace non-profits ranked by government grant revenue for 2024
K. C. Gross
Variety Children'S Hospital led non-profits in Coral Terrace, Florida in reported government grant revenue in 2024, with $30,025,959 in government grants reported in its IRS Form 990 filing and $1,042,898,787 in total revenue.
government grants made up 2.9% of its reported total revenue.
The ranking reflects non-profits with available Form 990-series government grant revenue data that met the ranking's data criteria and may not include every non-profit in the city.
The ranking is based on IRS Form 990 filings, the annual information returns most tax-exempt organizations file with the IRS. The form includes reported revenue, expenses, assets, governance information and compensation paid to certain people, making it a public source for comparing large tax-exempt organizations' finances.
The figures reflect what each organization reported for its filing year, including total revenue, contributions, government grants, compensation, the number of employees and assets at the start and end of the year. Because nonprofits can differ by mission, structure and accounting period, the totals are best read as reported financial measures, not as a direct measure of local charitable activity.
Among the 3 ranked organizations with calculable government-grant shares, the median share of revenue from government grants was 9.4%. The organization with the highest government-grant share was El Ingenio Inc, at 55.1%.
Variety Children'S Hospital reported $30,025,959 in government grant revenue in 2024, up from $23,586,163 in the prior year, an increase of $6,439,796 or 27.3%. El Ingenio Inc reported $189,793, compared to $176,393 in the previous year, an increase of $13,400 or 7.6%. Imago Por Las Artes Inc received $17,834 in 2024, up from $7,063 in the prior year, which was an increase of $10,771 or 152.5%.
Variety Children'S Hospital reported $45,528,283 in total contributions in 2024. Of that total, $57,135 was categorized as all other contributions. El Ingenio Inc reported total contributions of $189,793. Imago Por Las Artes Inc reported $190,709 in total contributions, with $172,875 categorized as all other contributions.
For assets, Variety Children'S Hospital's end-of-year asset balance increased from $1,637,315,414 at the beginning of the year to $1,774,367,898, a rise of 8.4%. El Ingenio Inc's assets went from $156,895 to $162,643, an increase of 3.7%. Imago Por Las Artes Inc's assets grew from $10,078 to $20,536, up 103.8%.
Tax-exempt organizations include a wide range of groups, such as charities, foundations, educational institutions and other mission-driven organizations. Under IRS rules, 501(c)(3) organizations must be organized and operated for exempt purposes, and their earnings cannot benefit private shareholders or individuals.
